Add Default impl for bitcrusher, compressor, distortion, gate, reverb,

sonido/8418a3b:
EffectType enum deleted — registry is now sole source of truth for effect
metadata. Added short_name to EffectDescriptor and descriptor() lookup so
chain_view and app.rs resolve display names from the registry instead of a
manually-maintained enum. Net -170 lines of redundant mapping code.

AudioProcessor struct extracted from the 160-line audio callback closure.
Owns ChainManager, FilePlayback, bridge, effect order, and metering.
Callback reduces to processor.process_buffer(data). Enables unit testing
the audio pipeline without live streams.

Unified stream storage: deleted AudioThread struct and sleep-loop on
native. Both native and wasm now store Vec<cpal::Stream> directly — cpal
manages its own audio threads. Simplified start_audio/stop_audio to
create/drop streams.

Transactional add/remove on ChainManager bundles chain + bridge + order
mutations into single calls, preventing desync. Individual remove methods
narrowed to pub(crate).

build_audio_streams() now takes &EffectRegistry from the caller instead
of creating a second instance.
two-top/846adc8:

name-seeded RNG stream so adding or reordering cues never perturbs the
others.

Add the title and match music loops (crossfaded by screen state), the
taunt horn, and the dash/dash-ready/charge-riser/respawn/sudden-death/
match-win/menu-tap event cues; drop the old ambient loop. Regenerate
every WAV.
clob/8450b26:
Add a --qat training mode for the dense trainer. In QAT mode each training step forwards and backwards through the effective ternary projection of the deployable matrix families, then applies those straight-through gradients to the underlying latent parameters. The default remains the prior latent surrogate path, so existing runs reproduce unless --qat is set.

Add a small recurrent-pattern gate proving the QAT path reduces effective-ternary NLL on the memory-requiring smoke corpus. This is a code gate, not a claim that QAT closes the diagnostic or real-corpus projection gap; those still need registered experiments.
noodles/848b660:
Unify: the chord editor's seven-block picker is deleted and the
circle itself takes its place - the same component, mounted small,
always armed because editing is the intent. Everything the key
sheet's wheel does works in the editor: blooms write sevenths,
dim wedges write borrowed chords, the mirror writes reflections,
rim travel and the door re-key and re-mode (rebuilding the open
editor so slots, staff, threads, and wheel re-speak together).
Strums gain a mount option: in the editor a drag across wedges
paints bars in a row, the origin joining the run and the selection
walking forward - a progression in one stroke. The editor column
now reads as four projections of one clip: engraved staff, named
slots, voice threads, the wheel.

Simplify: the picker and its CSS die; chordHex and the chordColor
import go with them. Empower the chrome: the footer KEY button
draws a live 26 px compass - twelve station dots, the sector arc,
a bright dot on the front door - so the key's whole story rides
the footer. Version to 0.3.0.

The humanizer learns about time zero on the way: offline renders
begin at transport 0, and a negative first-step jitter was an
invalid source start - all four jittered schedule times clamp at
zero now, a no-op live. Smoke strums the editor wheel through
synthetic pointers and asserts the bars changed.
